search.query: endothelial[Title] AND (identity[Title/Abstract] OR specification[Title/Abstract] OR reprogramming[Title/Abstract] OR "cell fate"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("transcription factor"[Title/Abstract] OR "transcription factors"[Title/Abstract] OR ETV2[Title/Abstract] OR ERG[Title/Abstract] OR FLI1[Title/Abstract] OR SOX17[Title/Abstract]) AND ("2015/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2026/10/05"[Date - Publication]) NOT (Review[Publication Type] OR Editorial[Publication Type] OR Comment[Publication Type])

esearchresult.querytranslation: ("endothelial"[Title] AND ("identity"[Title/Abstract] OR "specification"[Title/Abstract] OR "reprogramming"[Title/Abstract] OR "cell fate"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("transcription factor"[Title/Abstract] OR "transcription factors"[Title/Abstract] OR "ETV2"[Title/Abstract] OR "ERG"[Title/Abstract] OR "FLI1"[Title/Abstract] OR "SOX17"[Title/Abstract]) AND 2015/01/01:2026/10/05[Date - Publication]) NOT ("Review"[Publication Type] OR "Editorial"[Publication Type] OR "Comment"[Publication Type])

screening.criteria: English-readable experimental studies or protocols on TF control of endothelial specification, reprogramming, specialization, maintenance or loss; 2015 through 2026-10-05; target 25 diverse examples. Top 60 relevance-ranked PubMed hits only. Not exhaustive; relevant papers also excluded to meet pilot size. No minimum citation count or full-text availability requirement.
screening.selection_method: AI-assisted thematic selection; no human screening claimed.

provenance.method: Codex read the retrieved abstracts and drafted these annotations during the session. The collector uses this saved output. The exact deployed model identifier was unavailable.

records.model: Adult human dermal fibroblasts; in vivo vessel assay
records.finding: SOX17 combined with ETV2 improved fibroblast conversion and several endothelial functional readouts.
records.limitation: The abstract covers selected functional assays; it leaves long-term stability across tissue settings unresolved.
records.evidence_quote: by overexpressing SOX17 in conjunction with ETV2

records.model: Mouse partial carotid ligation
records.finding: Disturbed flow was associated with endothelial inflammatory and mesenchymal programs and altered motif accessibility.
records.limitation: Pseudotime and motif accessibility suggest changes in cell state; lineage tracing and perturbation would be needed to test the proposed transitions and regulators.
records.evidence_quote: single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and scATAC-seq

records.model: Adult mouse LSEC-specific Gata4 knockout; human cirrhosis datasets
records.finding: Loss of endothelial GATA4 induced sinusoidal capillarization and profibrotic signaling involving MYC and PDGFB.
records.limitation: The mouse knockout tests the effect of GATA4 loss. The human cirrhosis comparison is observational.
records.evidence_quote: LSEC-to-continuous endothelial transdifferentiation

records.model: Adult venous endothelial cultures; mouse artery/vein comparison
records.finding: COUP-TFII manipulation changed inflammatory, thrombotic and mesenchymal phenotypes of venous endothelial cells.
records.limitation: COUP-TFII accounts for part of a broader set of differences between arteries and veins.
records.evidence_quote: COUP-TFII knockdown also readily undergo endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition

records.model: Human iPSC cardiac/endothelial co-differentiation
records.finding: ETV2 expression dynamics distinguished early endothelial and cardiomyocyte lineage-predisposed states.
records.limitation: These reporter dynamics come from an in vitro differentiation system. Their relevance to development in vivo needs testing.
records.evidence_quote: a transient ETV2-high-state initiates the specification of endothelial cells

records.model: Engineered embryonic stem-cell differentiation and reprogramming models
records.finding: ETV2 bound nucleosomal DNA and recruited BRG1, linking pioneer activity to endothelial chromatin opening.
records.limitation: The mechanism comes from engineered differentiation and reprogramming models; its range across endothelial contexts remains a question.
records.evidence_quote: ETV2 was able to bind nucleosomal DNA and recruit BRG1

records.model: Human skin fibroblasts; mouse hindlimb ischemia assay
records.finding: ETV2 mRNA plus hypoxia generated endothelial progenitor-like cells from fibroblasts at low reported efficiency.
records.limitation: The reported conversion efficiency was low, and the functional test used a mouse ischemia model.
records.evidence_quote: ETV2 mRNA combined with hypoxia can give rise to functional EPCs

records.model: Human amniotic fluid-derived cells; implantation in mice
records.finding: A conversion platform combined transient ETV2 with sustained FLI1/ERG1 and TGF-beta inhibition to produce expandable endothelium.
records.limitation: This paper describes a conversion protocol. Its therapeutic usefulness would need separate testing.
records.evidence_quote: constitutive expression the ETS transcription factors FLI1 and ERG1

records.model: Cultured venous endothelial cells under controlled flow
records.finding: SOX17 induced arterial/tip-cell programs whose functional effects depended on mechanical and supporting-cell context.
records.limitation: Cultured venous cells under controlled flow capture only part of the environment in adult arteries.
records.evidence_quote: Sox17-induced ECs exhibit a gene profile favoring arterial and tip cell identity

records.model: Human adipose-derived stem cells in vitro
records.finding: PROX1 overexpression induced lymphatic endothelial-like markers and tube-forming behavior.
records.limitation: Marker expression and Matrigel tube formation leave mature lymphatic function unresolved.
records.evidence_quote: induced the differentiation of hADSCs into stable lymphatic endothelial-like cells

records.model: Human fibroblast conversion; vascular functional assays
records.finding: Activation of cAMP/EPAC/RAP1 enhanced ETV2-driven conversion and angiogenesis-related function.
records.limitation: The assays assess conversion and angiogenesis; broader comparisons with native endothelium would help establish how complete the conversion is.
records.evidence_quote: forskolin facilitated efficient and rapid iEC reprogramming

records.model: Mouse ESC/embryoid bodies and embryos
records.finding: ETV2 dosage and context promoted hematoendothelial programs while suppressing alternative mesodermal programs, including Mesp1.
records.limitation: The experiments use mouse developmental models, which may behave differently from human differentiation cultures.
records.evidence_quote: Master regulators of the cardiac lineage including Mesp1

records.model: Wharton jelly stromal cells; diabetic mouse wounds
records.finding: TWIST1 promoted endothelial programming of stromal cells and vascular repair readouts in diabetic mouse wounds.
records.limitation: The result depends on the starting stromal cells and experimental setting; TWIST1 can have different roles in other endothelial contexts.
records.evidence_quote: Twist1 reprogramming enhanced the endothelial lineage commitment of WJ-MSC

records.model: Chicken mesoderm, gecko and comparative avian genomics
records.finding: Ectopic ETV2 induced an endothelial-associated program in avian mesoderm without the corresponding hematopoietic response.
records.limitation: The ancestral regulatory model is an inference from comparative genomes and expression experiments.
records.evidence_quote: Mouse ETV2 induced LMO2, but not NPAS4L or SCL

records.model: Human iPSC-derived mesodermal progenitors
records.finding: ETV2 used both activating cofactors and REST-mediated repression of alternative-lineage genes during endothelial specification.
records.limitation: The experiments use induced differentiation. Whether the same mechanism operates across adult endothelial tissues needs testing.
records.evidence_quote: ETV2 recruited REST to repress non-EC lineage genes

records.model: Murine embryonic stem-cell model of embryonic blood development
records.finding: A targeted screen identified regulators whose loss biased mesoderm away from normal haemato-endothelial commitment.
records.limitation: The screen covers selected transcription factors and chromatin regulators in a mouse cell model.
records.evidence_quote: ETV2, LDB1, SMAD1, SIX4 and ZBTB7b

records.model: Differentiating mouse ESCs with inducible Runx1
records.finding: HOXB4 promoted hemogenic endothelium formation while preserving overall endothelial development.
records.limitation: The endpoint is hemogenic endothelium, a developmental state distinct from mature vascular endothelium.
records.evidence_quote: HOXB4 promoted the formation of hemogenic endothelium cells

records.model: Cardiac endothelial cells and isolated nuclei
records.finding: Cardiac endothelial cells showed cell-autonomous myofibrillar transcription and promoter accessibility that diminished in culture.
records.limitation: Motif enrichment points to possible regulators, but the abstract does not establish a causal role for an individual factor.
records.evidence_quote: have open chromatin at CMF gene promoters

records.model: Endothelial cultures, EndoMT models and heart-failure patient ECs
records.finding: TCF4 repressed TGF-beta-pathway genes and helped maintain endothelial phenotype against EndoMT.
records.limitation: TCF4 refers to ITF2 in this paper. The rescue experiments do not establish a treatment effect in patients.
records.evidence_quote: TCF4; also known as ITF2

records.model: Liver/heart/brain EC comparison and engineered HUVECs
records.finding: C-MAF, GATA4 and MEIS2 together increased a liver-sinusoidal marker program but did not fully recreate LSEC function.
records.limitation: The three-factor combination did not significantly induce receptor-mediated endocytosis, leaving an important LSEC function incomplete.
records.evidence_quote: receptor-mediated endocytosis was not significantly induced

records.model: Zebrafish embryos
records.finding: VEGF signaling levels influenced general endothelial differentiation and arterial specification, partly through etv2.
records.limitation: Both dose and developmental timing affect the result, and broad VEGFR inhibition also affects cell survival.
records.evidence_quote: Vegf signaling affects overall endothelial differentiation

records.model: Hypercholesterolemic mice, human plaques and cultured EndMT cells
records.finding: ERG loss promoted endothelial identity loss and atherosclerotic pathology; restoration reversed mesenchymal programs in culture.
records.limitation: The human plaque comparisons are observational. The restoration experiment tests cultured cells.
records.evidence_quote: ERG loss drove endothelial dedifferentiation

records.model: HUVEC EndMT model; atherosclerotic lesions
records.finding: SOX9 altered endothelial chromatin and induced persistent mesenchymal programs despite dynamic factor binding.
records.limitation: SOX9 was sufficient to drive changes in the tested setting, but its contribution relative to other EndMT regulators remains open.
records.evidence_quote: SOX9 expression alone is sufficient to activate mesenchymal genes

records.model: LSEC-specific Maf knockout mice and human liver datasets
records.finding: Endothelial c-Maf loss disrupted sinusoidal differentiation and zonation, with pathogenic endothelial subsets and liver fibrosis.
records.limitation: The mouse knockout tests c-Maf function; the human cirrhosis data show expression differences.
records.evidence_quote: a switch from sinusoidal to continuous endothelial cell identity

records.model: Mouse ESC differentiation and germline/conditional knockout models
records.finding: ETV2 initiated a hemangiogenic regulatory hierarchy that other ETS factors partly maintained after the initial specification phase.
records.limitation: The abstract leaves the contributions of individual downstream ETS factors only partly resolved.
records.evidence_quote: an ETS switching mechanism
